claim_ceiling: MNP detection and clinical association within explicitly bounded human samples; no general-population causal claim
required_layers: original cohort design, sample selection, exposure assay and clinical endpoints
contamination controls, blanks, labware, air, reagents, recovery and polymer confirmation
confounding, selection, reverse causality, missing data and model specification
independent human vascular or cardiovascular-sample replication
methodological heterogeneity across pyrolysis-GC/MS, Raman/IR and microscopy
separate clinical-event, biomarker, animal and in-vitro evidence
precommitted_downgrade: if contamination controls or independent replication do not support the exposure classification, retain only a contested research signal; if no independent human replication is found, do not claim causal confirmation
next_action: read the original NEJM study and supplement, the methodological correspondence, independent human-sample evidence, and a current evidence synthesis in full
